narrative.overview:
The site should feel like walking into a small-town Kanzlei where people look up and say hello. One warm mauve carries the whole brand, inherited unchanged from the legacy site kanzlei-karstenwalz.de. White pages, soft cards with rounded corners and quiet shadows, real team photos under a mauve veil. Nothing is loud or showy, and nothing is cold. Phone number, address and a "Kontakt" button are always close.

Density is relaxed: generous section padding, short paragraphs, grids of four or three cards at most. Craft goes into an invisible layer instead of decoration: fast scroll reveals, a cursor spotlight on cards, buttons that drift slightly toward the cursor, page cross-fades that keep the header still. This layer is the only place the design may grow. The client approved the look on 2026-06-12 and rejected an editorial redesign (square corners, uppercase display type, chapter numbers, eyebrow labels). That rejection is binding.
keyCharacteristics: One brand hue in three tones (Deep Mauve, Dusty Mauve, Rose Ash) on white and off-white.
Open Sans only; section headings in the legacy style (uppercase, normal weight, mauve).
Rounded cards (12–16px) with soft shadows that lift on hover.
Photo heroes under a left-to-right mauve gradient with thin drifting circles.
A short Rose Ash bar under every heading.
Motion is polish, never a loading state; reduced motion turns it off completely.

rules.name: The One Hue Rule
rules.body: Every brand moment is Deep Mauve or a tint of Rose Ash. If a new element seems to need blue, green or gold, it doesn't.

rules.name: The White-On-Mauve Rule
rules.body: On a mauve surface, text and buttons are white or white at reduced opacity (70–90%). Mauve text never sits on mauve.

rules.name: The Legacy Heading Rule
rules.body: Headings inside `main` are uppercase, weight 400, Deep Mauve. Exceptions: h1s on mauve heroes and the h2 in the mauve contact section are white and bold, set by utility classes that override the base rule. Footer headings stay outside the rule.

rules.name: The Phone-As-Headline Rule
rules.body: In the contact section the phone number is set as large as a headline (1.875 → 2.25rem, bold, white). Calling is the main action.

rules.name: The Earned Lift Rule
rules.body: A shadow grows only when the visitor's pointer is on the element. Resting cards never compete for attention.

rules.name: The No-Square-Corners Rule
rules.body: Nothing interactive or framed has a 0 radius. The client explicitly rolled back a square-cornered editorial version.

dos: **Do** use Deep Mauve for every brand moment and Dusty Mauve only for hover.
**Do** put a Rose Ash bar under every section heading and animate it with `data-bar`.
**Do** keep cards at 12–16px radius with a Rose Ash 15% border and `shadow-sm`, lifting on hover.
**Do** use real team photos from `public/images/team/` for people and heroes.
**Do** keep reveals fast (0.5s, 0.06s stagger, 20px travel, `power2.out`) and fully disabled under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
**Do** keep the phone number and a Kontakt action visible on every page.
donts: **Don't** introduce eyebrow labels or chapter numbers above sections (client decision 2026-06-12).
**Don't** use square corners, uppercase display type for h1s, or an editorial magazine layout. That version was rolled back.
**Don't** add a second accent colour or change the font.
**Don't** let an animation delay content: no entrance replay on internal navigation, no slow fades.
**Don't** present the AI-generated images in `public/images/generated/` as photos of the Kanzlei.
